description_text: Starved Rock State Park features 18 canyons, sandstone cliffs, waterfalls, and scenic trails along the Illinois River, serving as one of the state's top natural destinations.
campground_text: Campground provides 133 Class-A premium sites with 30/50 amp electricity, water hydrants, modern shower buildings, and flush toilets.

description_text: Rock Cut State Park covers over 3,000 acres in northern Illinois, featuring Pierce Lake and Olson Lake for boating, swimming, fishing, and extensive trail networks.
campground_text: Features over 270 sites total (including 210 electric Class A sites), modern showers, flush toilets, a camp store, and a dump station. Alcohol is prohibited.

description_text: Chain O' Lakes State Park borders three natural lakes and the Fox River, offering extensive water recreation, boating, and wildlife viewing in a scenic glacial landscape.
campground_text: Campground provides 151 Class-A electric sites, 87 Class-B electric/standard sites, youth camping, flush toilets, and shower houses.

park_name: Adeline Jay Geo-Karis Illinois Beach State Park
description_text: Illinois Beach State Park protects the only remaining beach ridge shoreline in the state, offering sandy beaches, dunes, oak savannas, and views of Lake Michigan.
campground_text: South Unit campground offers 241 Class A electric sites, modern restrooms/showers, and an RV dump station.

description_text: Kankakee River State Park stretches along both sides of the Kankakee River, offering wooded hiking trails, limestone canyons, canoeing, and excellent fishing.
campground_text: Potawatomi campground features 110 Class A electric sites with showers. Chippewa campground features 98 sites (Class B electric and Class C primitive).

description_text: Matthiessen State Park features beautiful sandstone canyons, mineral springs, and unusual rock formations along a scenic mile-long canyon, located just south of Starved Rock.
